note: The CAPS subjects and topics a skill's "caps" references may use, written "CAPS <subject> Gr <grade>: <topic>" (for example "CAPS Mathematics Gr 1: Addition and subtraction"). CAPS has no short codes like Cambridge's, so the references name the subject, grade and topic as the CAPS documents do. Home Language and First Additional Language follow the same CAPS structure in English and Afrikaans, so one name serves both. Topics are the Foundation Phase ones (Grade R to 3, CAPS 2011; Coding and Robotics from the Grade R to 3 draft); Grade 4 topics are added with the first stage4 skills. Every topic here still has to be checked against the CAPS documents (docs/CURRICULUM_5_10.md, decision 6). gradeForBand is the grade that matches each band; a reference may be one grade either side of it.
